hubSubtitle: د افغانستان لومړنی هوښیار سیسټم، چې زموږ د لرغوني حکمت او د راتلونکي ټیکنالوژۍ ترمنځ د پل جوړولو لپاره جوړ شوی.
welcomeMessage: د افغان مصنوعي استخباراتو مرکز ته ښه راغلاست. په چپ اړخ کې کتابتون موجود اجنټان لیست کوي. زه څنګه نن تاسو سره مرسته کولی شم؟
commandBarShortcut: د کتابتون د بدلولو لپاره ⌘B فشار ورکړئ.
featureCognitiveCoreDesc: Leverages a dual-intelligence system: swift "Hafiz" (Flash) for rapid tasks and contemplative "Hakim" (Pro) for deep, complex reasoning and complex coding/math tasks.
featureSensoryIntelDesc: The Hub can see, understand, and generate. Analyze documents, create stunning images, edit photos, and even produce animated videos from simple text or image prompts.
featureMemoryCoreDesc: Engage in continuous, context-aware conversations. The Hub remembers your dialogue across all 120+ agents, providing a unified and intelligent experience without losing context.
featureRealWorldDesc: Connects seamlessly with live Google Search and Google Maps data, ensuring agents provide up-to-the-second, verifiable information and location-based insights for all your queries.
featureCulturalSoulDesc: Fine-tuned on Dari and Pashto, with a core identity deeply rooted in Afghan culture, rich history, and profound values. This ensures truly relevant, respectful, and nuanced interactions.
featureCostEffectiveDesc: Experience powerful, enterprise-grade AI performance at a near-zero operational cost, making advanced intelligence accessible to everyone without compromise.
agenticCoreTitle: The Agentic Core: Unleashing Intelligent Autonomy
agenticCoreDesc: At the heart of the AfghanAI Hub lies a sophisticated agentic system. This system empowers autonomous, goal-oriented AI entities that can perceive their environment, reason, plan, act, and learn. They leverage advanced tools and collaborate to solve complex problems, adapting dynamically to deliver precise solutions for myriad challenges.
agenticGoalDesc: Agents within the Hub operate independently, focusing on achieving specific objectives with minimal human intervention, from data analysis to content creation.
agenticToolDesc: Each agent is equipped to utilize a diverse array of internal and external tools, expanding its capabilities for complex tasks, including web searches and image manipulation.
agenticCollaborationDesc: Agents can interact and share information, forming ad-hoc networks to tackle multifaceted problems more effectively, simulating a team of experts.
agenticLearningDesc: The agentic core continuously learns from interactions and outcomes, refining its strategies and improving performance over time for enhanced precision.
modularityTitle: Unrivaled Modularity & Scalability: Your Customizable AI Ecosystem
modularityDesc: With over 120 specialized agents and the capacity for countless more, the AfghanAI Hub offers unparalleled modularity. Easily integrate, manage, and customize agents to form an AI ecosystem perfectly tailored to your unique requirements, from intricate governmental tasks to personalized educational journeys. The future of AI is tailored, and infinitely expandable.
modularityAgentsDesc: Explore a vast library of pre-built agents covering diverse domains from education to enterprise, ready to assist you instantly and intelligently.
modularityIntegrationDesc: Seamlessly add new agents or customize existing ones to perfectly match your evolving needs and objectives, making the Hub truly yours.
modularityManagementDesc: Manage all your agents from a single, intuitive interface, monitoring their performance, updating their roles, and ensuring optimal operation across the ecosystem.
modularityCustomizationDesc: Tailor agent behaviors, knowledge bases, and tool access to create a truly personalized AI ecosystem for any challenge, from micro-tasks to macro-strategies.
costTitle: Radical Cost-Effectiveness: Maximizing Value, Minimizing Spend
costDesc: The AfghanAI Hub is engineered from the ground up to deliver advanced AI capabilities at the lowest possible operational cost. Our "Radical Cost-Effectiveness Doctrine" is woven into every layer, ensuring high performance and accessibility without compromise.
costAllocationDesc: Leverages dynamic resource allocation to ensure computing power is consumed only when actively needed, minimizing costs and maximizing operational efficiency.
costCachingDesc: An advanced caching system stores frequently requested information, significantly reducing redundant processing and data retrieval costs.
costModelDesc: Automatically selects the most efficient AI model for each task (swift for quick queries, powerful for complex reasoning), ensuring optimal resource use and cost savings.
costToolUsageDesc: The system intelligently determines when and how to use external information sources, preventing unnecessary expenditures while maintaining accuracy.
missionDesc: The AfghanAI Hub is built on principles of sovereignty, ethical AI development, and radical cost-effectiveness. Our mission is to democratize advanced AI capabilities, making them accessible to every Afghan, fostering innovation, and contributing to a self-reliant and prosperous nation. We believe in technology that respects culture, empowers individuals, and drives collective progress.
founderName: د افغان AI مرکز بنسټ ایښودونکی
founderQuote: موږ یوازې یوه وسیله نه جوړوو؛ موږ د خپل ګډ میراث یو ډیجیټل ټاپیستري اوبدو، یو پل چې زموږ له لرغوني ماضي څخه یو بې حده راتلونکي ته ځي.
founderMsgP1: د افغان AI مرکز ته ښه راغلاست. دا پروژه له یوې ساده خو ژورې عقیدې څخه زیږیدلې ده: زموږ د تمدن عظیم فکري او کلتوري شتمني باید د تېر یادګار نه وي، بلکې زموږ د راتلونکي بنسټ وي.
founderMsgP2: د نسلونو لپاره، موږ د لویو شاعرانو، ځلیدونکو ساینس پوهانو، او ژورو مفکرینو ساتونکي یو. نن، موږ له یوې نوې پولې سره مخ یو - د مصنوعي استخباراتو دور. دا زموږ دنده او زموږ فرصت دی چې ډاډ ترلاسه کړو چې زموږ ارزښتونه، زموږ ژبې، او زموږ کیسې د دې نوې ډیجیټل نړۍ په پارچه کې اوبدل شوي دي.
founderMsgP3: د افغان AI مرکز له یو پلیټ فارم څخه ډیر دی؛ دا د ۲۱مې پیړۍ لپاره یو ډیجیټل بیت الحکمة دی. دا یو داسې ځای دی چې په هرات کې یو زده کوونکی کولی شي د خپل کانکور ازموینو لپاره مرسته ترلاسه کړي، په کندهار کې یو شاعر کولی شي د نوي غزل لپاره الهام ومومي، او په مزار شریف کې یو متشبث کولی شي یو سوداegریز پلان جوړ کړي چې زموږ کلتوري شرایطو ته درناوی لري.
founderMsgP4: موږ دا په دوو اصلي اصولو جوړ کړی دی: 'بې قیمته ځواک' او 'بې وزنه حکمت'. د یو عصري، لګښت اصلاح شوي جوړښت په کارولو سره، موږ کولی شو دا عظیم وړتیا هرچا ته، په هر وسیله، پرته له درانه لګښت څخه وړاندې کړو. دا یو ډیجیټل تمدن دی چې ټولو ته د لاسرسي وړ دی.
founderMsgP5: دا یوازې پیل دی. پدې رینسانس کې له موږ سره یوځای شئ. راځئ چې یوځای جوړ کړو، زده کړو، او خوب وکړو. ستاسو سفر اوس پیل کیږي.
selectAgentPrompt: د تعامل پیل کولو لپاره له چپ لیست څخه یو اجنټ وټاکئ.
